criteria.statement: Hard-25 reproduced from local material with ids only in a git-ignored path, or the build parked
5-fold CV meets check >= 430, tuning >= 410, every-rule check >= 140, hard 25 >= 15
Final model meets corpus >= 410, >= 355 all-rule cases, bench@5 >= 118, Necropotence 514.1/514.2/514.3a in top ten in both versions
Leak check and latency/quantization check run and counts recorded
Manifest committed with correct hashes and every committed vector file records the trained model id
Benchmark floors 0.8526/0.8333 and all 14 labelled checks pass on the trained model, with cap 15, the 0.6 cutoff and keyword sets as shipped defaults
Rules gate re-baselined once, every lost hit listed, net hits up
No weight files tracked and privacy-scan reports 0
Stemming-case ranks and rule characters per prompt recorded
Upload commands doc committed outside PRD/work
